name: Clarissa S Holy Defense
body:
School abjuration [good]; Level cleric/oracle/warpriest 4, inquisitor 4, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.-radius burst
Area all allies within a 30 ft. radius burst centered on you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance you

DESCRIPTION

Your deity shows you favor and protects you in your struggle. You and each of your affected allies gain a +2 sacred bonus to your armor class and saving throws. This bonus increases to +4 when being attacked by undead and evil outsiders.
